Class MovementRegistry

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.MovementRegistry
public class MovementRegistry extends Object
Maps movement names to factories that build actual effect objects.

A movement name is a recipe name, such as wave or 3d. Its factory receives palette and speed controls and creates an effect. The built-in Kotlin bootstrap registers the original 28 names; other mods can add namespaced names such as your_mod/ripple.

The constructor controls colorSpeed and moveSpeed are interpreted by each factory. For example, moveSpeed sets a size multiplier for size, extra GUI pixels for spacing, and a layer count for 3d. Some factories ignore one or both controls. The separate animationSpeed argument changes sampled time; it does not change these constructor values. See the control and option reference for built-in fallback values and units.

Writes replace the immutable factory map and clear inline caches so future lookups use the new factories. Already created effect objects are not rewritten. Factories run on the requesting thread; callbacks should create/configure a new instance before publishing it.

    • has

      public static boolean has(String id)
      Checks the base movement name of an optional descriptor without validating its options.

      This lookup does not invoke the factory. A later create call still validates the descriptor, speeds and palette.

      Parameters:
      id - movement name or semicolon-option descriptor, or null
      Returns:
      true if the normalized base name has a registered factory; false for null or unknown names

    • create

      public static IChromaticEffect create(String id, float colorSpeed, float moveSpeed, List<Integer> colors)
      Builds a movement using validated finite speeds and a copied nonempty RGB palette.

      Palette integers are masked to 24 bits. A configurable effect receives its palette even when there are no explicit options. A descriptor containing semicolons is routed through the option-aware overload with playback rate one.

      Parameters:
      id - registered movement name, optionally followed by semicolon-separated options
      colorSpeed - finite palette-rate control interpreted by the selected effect
      moveSpeed - finite geometry/motion control interpreted by the selected effect
      colors - non-null, nonempty list of non-null packed RGB integers
      Returns:
      newly built effect returned by the registered callback
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the movement is unknown or inputs/options are invalid
      NullPointerException - if a required input or the factory result is null

    • create

      public static IChromaticEffect create(String id, float colorSpeed, float moveSpeed, List<Integer> colors, float animationSpeed, Map<String,?> options)
      Builds and configures a movement, then applies an independent playback multiplier.

      Explicit options override matching keys in the movement descriptor. Primary/secondary RGB options replace the corresponding palette entries before construction, extending a short palette with white entries when needed. Unsupported options fail rather than being silently ignored. Geometry values remain independent of playback speed.

      Playback can wrap the result. Use TimedEffect.base(IChromaticEffect) to inspect the underlying effect's concrete type, including ConfigurableTextEffect.parameters() and ConfigurableTextEffect.settings().

      Parameters:
      id - registered movement name or option descriptor
      colorSpeed - finite effect-specific color control
      moveSpeed - finite effect-specific movement/geometry control
      colors - input palette copied before applying color options
      animationSpeed - finite playback multiplier in the range -32 through 32
      options - explicit supported option values, overriding descriptor keys
      Returns:
      configured effect, possibly wrapped by TimedEffect
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any movement, option, range or palette is invalid
      NullPointerException - if a required input or factory result is null

    • create

      public static IChromaticEffect create(String id, float colorSpeed, float moveSpeed, List<Integer> colors, float animationSpeed)
      Builds a movement with its descriptor options and a separate playback speed.

      Use TimedEffect.base(IChromaticEffect) to inspect the concrete effect when playback wraps the result.

      Parameters:
      id - registered movement name or descriptor
      colorSpeed - finite effect-specific color control
      moveSpeed - finite effect-specific movement/geometry control
      colors - non-null, nonempty RGB palette
      animationSpeed - playback multiplier from -32 through 32; zero freezes initial time
      Returns:
      effect with its original geometry and requested playback multiplier
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if construction or playback validation fails
      NullPointerException - if a required input or factory result is null

    • parseOptions

      public static Map<String,Object> parseOptions(String descriptor)
      Reads semicolon-separated option assignments into an immutable map.

      The glyphs value remains text. Values beginning with a hash become hexadecimal integers; other numeric values become doubles. This step checks descriptor shape and duplicate keys; the effect's parameter rules perform the later type/range validation.

      Parameters:
      descriptor - base name followed by at most 32 option assignments and at most 2048 characters
      Returns:
      explicit option values, excluding the base movement name
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if bounds, assignments, duplicates or number syntax are invalid
      NullPointerException - if descriptor is null

    • scoped

      public static AutoCloseable scoped(String id, MovementRegistry.MovementFactory factory)
      Registers a factory with identity-safe cleanup for an unloadable contribution.

      A fresh forwarding wrapper identifies this registration even if two callers reuse the same callback object. Closing the older scope therefore preserves a replacement.

      Parameters:
      id - normalized movement identity to register
      factory - non-null effect-construction callback
      Returns:
      cleanup handle; repeated closure is harmless once this binding is absent
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if id is invalid
      NullPointerException - if id or factory is null
